words.example: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.

words.translation: 惊恐，忧虑，警报 (n.)；使惊恐， 使担心 (vt.)
words.example: When the students heard the fire alarm, they left the building.

words.translation: 虚弱的， 衰弱的， 无力的； 无效的， 无益的 (adj.)
words.example: The boy was too feeble to carry the object very far.

words.translation: 估计， 估量； 评价 (n.)
连续的； 频频的 (adj.)
药草， 香草； 草本植物 (n.)
words.example: I couldn’t decide which herb I wanted to buy at the market.

words.translation: 散文 (n.)
肢， 臂， 腿； 树枝 (n.)
words.example: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.

words.translation: 方向， 目标， 方位； 熟悉情况， 适应， 情况介绍 (n.)
茶点， 点心； 恢复， 精神爽快 (n.)
信任， 信赖； 信心， 自信 (n.)
words.example: I have confidence that I did well on the test.

words.translation: 专心的， 专注的； 急切的 (adj.)；意图，意向，目的 (n.)
words.example: Her intent is to visit Italy next summer.

words.translation: 被动的， 消极的 (adj.)
words.example: Marcie is so passive that she never solves her own problems.

words.translation: 肥料 (n.)
相应的， 符合的 (adj.)
誓言， 誓约； 咒骂， 诅咒语 (n.)
words.example: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.

words.translation: 回答， 答复； 反应， 响应 (n.)
words.example: He asked if I was sad. My response was “No.”

words.translation: 条约， 协议， 协定 (n.)
庄严， 端庄； 尊严， 高贵 (n.)
words.example: When his company went out of business, he faced it with dignity.

words.translation: 挑战，邀请比赛；艰巨的任务；怀疑，质问 (n.)；反对， 公然反抗； 向…挑战； 对…质疑 (vt.)
words.example: It was a challenge to climb to the top of the mountain.

words.translation: 竞争的，对抗的 (adj.)；竞争对手，敌手；可与匹敌的人 (n.)；与…竞争； 与…匹敌， 比得上 (vt.)
words.example: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.
